integrity: A self-contained attachment proof and S4 Lefschetz certificate are supplied, with independently runnable finite checks. Public literature comparisons are not a mathematical proof of absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: At a single inclusive Hamming-distance scale 2 and weight cutoff 3; rational coordinate-permutation representations for n>=3. Does not determine persistent module maps for all cutoffs, integral homology lattices, or equivariant homotopy type. The nonequivariant rank follows from earlier full-cube link analysis and is not asserted original.
title: Coordinate-permutation homology of the weight-three function–Rips sublevel on Boolean cubes
